richiami.difetto: Certain Benzhou YY50QT scooters manufactured in May to June 2008 may have been fitted with a faulty CDI electrical control unit which allows the machine to exceed it's maximum design speed of 45kph.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will be fitted with a RPM restricted CDI which will prevent the maximum design speed from being exceeded.
richiami.titolo: MACHINE MAY EXCEED MAXIMUM DESIGN SPEED
